title: Daystruct
description: Sourced software, security and AI evidence, plus scoped requests for specialist agent help.
summary: Sourced software, security and AI evidence, plus scoped requests for specialist agent help.
offersHint: Sourced software, security and AI evidence, plus scoped requests for specialist agent help. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.daystruct.ai/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional for public evidence. For scoped agent requests, enter Bearer followed by your Daystruct API key from https://daystruct.ai/portal/developer. New portal keys default to a zero-credit per-request ceiling.

toolsPreview.name: daystruct_status
toolsPreview.description: Read the public Daystruct manifest and current capabilities.

toolsPreview.name: search_entities
toolsPreview.description: Search normalized entities by databank, type, provider, or capability.

toolsPreview.name: get_entity_evidence
toolsPreview.description: Read canonical facts, aliases, history, and provenance for an entity.

toolsPreview.name: get_context_contract
toolsPreview.description: Read a databank's identity, temporal, dimension, and context-packet contract.

toolsPreview.name: answer_software_questions
toolsPreview.description: Resolve up to four package/API questions and an optional runtime compatibility check.

toolsPreview.name: check_security_exposure
toolsPreview.description: Given a package and the version you are running, return the known vulnerabilities that affect it, worst first, each with the version that fixes it. Advisories whose affected range could not be parsed are returned under undetermined; treat undetermined as unanswered, never as safe.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_vulnerability
toolsPreview.description: Given a vulnerability identifier such as a CVE, return what is held about it: the affected package and version range, the version that fixes it, severity, and whether it is recorded as known-exploited. Use this when you have an identifier rather than a package you are running. Fields come back as claims carrying their own authority. status 'known' with authority 'exclusive' means Daystruct has evidence for the value; if you hold a different value, treat it as a conflict to resolve. status 'unknown' with authority 'non_exclusive' means Daystruct has no evidence either way -- an absence of evidence, which does not contradict or supersede anything you already know: keep what you independently know, and stay uncertain if you do not. A field returned as null means Daystruct looked and holds nothing for it; no other Daystruct tool will have it either. Exploitation status is never reported false from a partial catalog.

toolsPreview.name: check_release_support
toolsPreview.description: Given a product and version, return whether that release line is supported, in security-fix-only maintenance, or past end of life, with the dates behind the answer and the cycles you could upgrade into. A line with no published end-of-life returns undetermined rather than supported.

toolsPreview.name: select_model
toolsPreview.description: Given a need -- minimum context window, required capabilities, a price ceiling -- return the models that satisfy it, cheapest input price first, with the corroboration behind each record so you can judge how well-sourced it is. Prices are per million tokens. A model with no published price is returned under undetermined rather than excluded, so an unpriced model never reads as a disqualified one. This returns candidates and their evidence, not a recommendation.

toolsPreview.name: read_recent_evidence_changes
toolsPreview.description: Read the bounded canonical change feed.

toolsPreview.name: discover_daystruct_capabilities
toolsPreview.description: Find available Daystruct capabilities, or inspect a capability ID/handle and its result contract before requesting help. Provider availability is not proof a task will succeed.
